model_annotation: The chart illustrates the effect of various language families on different models, comparing the performance across multiple categories. The horizontal axis lists the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with major ticks at intervals of 10 and minor ticks at intervals of 2. The chart features six groups of bars, each representing a different model: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (light green), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (red). Each group consists of bars corresponding to the language families on the horizontal axis, with approximate values ranging from 1 to 25; for instance, the IE-Indo group has the tallest bar, with the mBERT-B2 model (pink) at around 25 and the IE-Isolate group has one of the shortest bars, with most models at or near 0. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding; error bars are also included for each data point.
